decisions.summary: Vaishnavi Enterprises mark is the 'Power Ring': an open power-symbol ring in brand-orange-600 with a bolt passing through the 12 o'clock gap. Implemented in src/components/brand/Logo.tsx; three alternates (monogram, badge, rotor) ship behind the same `variant` prop.
decisions.rationale: Covers the whole catalogue (EV, UPS, fans, LED) rather than one category, stays legible at 16px, works one-colour, and replaces the generic lucide `Zap` placeholder. Flat fills only, matching the light token set.
decisions.usage: Wordmark: Inter extrabold 'Vaishnavi' over uppercase 'Enterprises' at 0.18em tracking in brand-orange-600. The mark's bolt uses currentColor, so set text-slate-900 on light surfaces and text-white on surface-inverse.
